_instructions: Spec template for `kappmaker mascot-animate --spec <file>` — a single short animation clip of the mascot (source image passed as reference).

This is a proven BASELINE, not a rigid schema — enrich freely. The mechanical rules that keep the clip usable as an app/marketing loop are in loop_rules and constraints: character identity unchanged, loop-friendly start/end pose, static camera, unchanged background, no text.
Describe ONE motion, concretely (what moves, how fast, what mood). Duration/resolution/model are CLI flags, not spec fields.
Animate only the states you actually need — video generation is priced per second.
loop_rules: Subtle, loop-friendly motion: the character starts and ends in (or near) the same pose so the clip loops cleanly
The mascot stays centered; static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts
The background stays exactly as in the source image — flat and unchanged, nothing enters the frame
consistency_rules: The character's identity, style, colors and proportions stay EXACTLY as in the source image — no redesign
Motion expressed through pose, gesture and facial expression only
constraints: NO TEXT WHATSOEVER: no words, letters, numbers, icons with text meaning, UI elements, speech bubbles, emojis, watermarks or logos
